# slup-geo

> Self-hosted OSM geocoder & map tiles in one Docker container: address search (`/v1/suggest`),
> point location (`/v1/point`), GeoJSON boundaries (`/v1/areas`), PMTiles + MapLibre style
> (`/tiles/*`). No external APIs, keys or CDNs. MIT.

- Repo: https://github.com/laantern/slup-geo
- Image: `aliakseikarpenka/slup-geo:latest` (Docker Hub), platforms: linux/amd64, linux/arm64
- Docs: README.md (quick start, ENV table, nginx, FAQ), openapi.yaml (API), CHANGELOG.md
- Licenses: MIT; map attribution `© OpenMapTiles · © OpenStreetMap contributors` (see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md)

## Quick start

```yaml
services:
  geo:
    image: aliakseikarpenka/slup-geo:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PBF_URL: https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/belarus-latest.osm.pbf
    volumes:
      - geo_data:/data
volumes:
  geo_data:
```

First start imports the PBF and builds tiles (minutes). Readiness: `GET /health` returns
`{"status":"ok"}` only when data is ready (`starting`/`no_data` → 503 otherwise).
Demo page: `GET /example`. Diagnostics: `GET /status`.

## Endpoints

- `GET /v1/suggest?q=<2..128 chars>` — up to 10 suggestions (streets → houses, admin zones), Russian normalization
- `GET /v1/point?lat=&lon=` — nearest house (≤5 m) + covering zones, ready-made `text`
- `GET /v1/areas/{id}?simplify=display|none` — GeoJSON (Polygon/MultiPolygon for zones, Point for node addresses)
- `GET /tiles/style.json`, `/tiles/basemap.pmtiles` (Range), `/tiles/fonts/...`, `/tiles/vendor/...`
- `GET /health`, `GET /status`

`/v1/*` is an internal API (no auth): call it from your private network; publish only `/tiles/*`.

## Key facts for agents

- Update is non-destructive: staging tables + atomic swap; a failed update keeps old data serving.
- Update pipeline: PBF download (https-only, validated) → tilemaker → osm2pgsql staging → swap+views → publish tiles.
- Config is ENV-only (see README table). No config files.
- Tests: `go test ./...`; integration SQL tests: `TEST_DATABASE_URL=... go test -tags=integration ./internal/geo/...`.
